data.long_meaning: Peram is a unisex name in Hinduism, derived from the name of the Hindu deity Lord Vishnu, also known as Perumal in Tamil. This name signifies strength, victory, and loyalty. It is a revered name, often given to children as a symbol of devotion and spiritual connection. The name Peram carries the meaning “Lord Perumal or the Lord Vishnu” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Peram usually hope their child will grow to embody lord perumal or the lord vishnu and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Peram belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Perumal or the Lord Vishnu.”
